value.body: A front office executive works at a hotel's front desk, handling check-in and check-out, reservations, billing and guest requests. Hotels and resorts hire for this role. Work is in shifts, including nights and weekends.

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Hotel property management system (PMS), reservation software

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join through campus placement or hotel walk-ins as a front office associate or executive. Good spoken English and, where relevant, a regional or foreign language help.

value.title: At a glance
items: Typical path: front office supervisor, duty manager, front office manager.
Shift work and standing for long hours are part of the role.
Experience here can lead to guest relations or sales roles.
